input.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 photo, a single frame from a phone-shot UGC video. Edit image 1 and change ONLY her hair.
Image 1 is the shot to keep: an older Black grandmother seen from behind, lavender sweater, bright window light, her left fingertips holding the hair open at a neat part on the crown, her right hand holding the small castor oil roll-on with the pink ball on the scalp at the part.
THE ONE CHANGE: her hair is now much longer. Long natural coily hair falling loose from the crown, past her shoulders and down her back to below the bottom edge of the frame, full and voluminous, covering the back of the lavender sweater and the back of her neck. Keep the SAME hair colour and texture as image 1: silver-grey and salt-and-pepper, mostly grey with some darker strands, the same tight springy coils (type 4 coily), never straightened, never wavy, never smooth, never white-blonde, never dyed. The neat part on the crown stays where the pink ball touches the scalp.
Keep everything else exactly as image 1: the room, the window on the left, the light, the framing and camera angle, both hands in the same place with the same brown skin with fine wrinkles, the same short natural nails, the thin gold ring on her left hand, the lavender sleeves.
Image 2 is the real front label of the roll-on: it matches image 2 letter for letter and colour for colour (Body4You, CASTOR OIL in purple, the green USDA ORGANIC seal). Image 3 is the product sheet: keep the exact small squat amber glass bottle, white collar and pink rose quartz ball at the same small size and angle as image 1, about as tall as her index finger.
Never her face. Exactly two hands, both hers. No text, no captions, no watermarks, no extra objects. Bright, clean, neutral daylight, true colours, no yellow or golden tint, no dark or moody look.

input.prompt:
Recreate image 1 exactly as the first frame: keep its room, window light, framing, her two hands and her long grey coily hair exactly.
Image 2 is the real front label of the castor oil roll-on (Body4You, CASTOR OIL in purple, the green USDA ORGANIC seal): it stays on the bottle the whole clip and matches image 2 letter for letter and colour for colour.
Image 3 is the product sheet: keep this exact small squat amber glass bottle, white collar and pink rose quartz ball, the same small size in every frame, no added marks, no ® or ™, no extra text.
Motion: her right hand keeps one grip on the roll-on, pink ball pressed on the scalp, and rolls it slowly along the part from front to back; a thin shiny line of oil follows the ball. Her left fingertips stay still, holding the hair open at the part. Her long grey coils stay the same length, colour and tight coily texture the whole clip and only sway a little. The bottle never turns, flips or changes hands.
Exactly two hands, both hers, on her own raised arms as in image 1, whole wrists. Never her face; no new hands, no other people.
Camera: locked off with a slight handheld drift. Vertical 9:16 phone footage, bright neutral daylight, realistic skin and hair.
No music, no voice, no captions, no on-screen text.
